message: guard-zero-tests.sh uses set -euo pipefail (line 2). On bash 5.3, pipefail combined with command substitution containing a failing grep triggers shell exit via set -e. Pattern 1 (grep for 'running [0-9]+ tests?$') greedily matches real cargo test output before the bug manifests. Pattern 3 (grep for 'cargo test: [0-9]+ passed') is unreachable — it can never be reached because either Pattern 1 matches (bypassing it) or grep fails in Pattern 1 (killing the script). The script works with current cargo output format but is fragile against format changes or condensed output (e.g., under rtk wrapper).
required_fix: Remove pipefail from set -euo pipefail, or use grep ... || true inside command substitutions, or suppress set -e for grep patterns.
